profile.headline: Information Technology and Services Professional
profile.jobTitle: IT Services Professional | IT Support | Computer Systems Analyst | Software Developer | Programmer
profile.summary:
Information Technology and Management Information Services Professional

Providing expertise in business analysis, systems and application programming development and support, and IT management. I’m targeting services to individual, startups, and small to large complex environments at various organizational levels in both profit and non-profit sectors. Bringing a background in the industries of higher education, manufacturing, insurance, retail distribution, government, and banking. 

Differentiation factor is a diverse combination of technical, business, and communication skills.

A reliable and innovative analyst, with a strong understanding of business process and software development. Demonstrated ability to effectively ensure systems operate smoothly and efficiently. Exemplary client relations and detail-oriented skills. Dependable and dedicated, with an authentic commitment to quality and customer contentment.

Specialties:
• Systems Development and Support. 
• Application Development and Support. 
• Business Process Analysis
• Software Maintenance
• Documentation & Reporting
• Software Implementation
• Database ETL
• Software/Data Conversion
• Scheduling and Operations
• Computer Operations.
• Technical Training
• MIS Management.

positions.title: IT Services Professional | IT Support | Computer Systems Analyst | Software Developer | Programmer
positions.description:
IT Consulting Services and Solutions Tailored to Your Business

Currently seeking new opportunities - Direct or Contract Employment

This expertise spans the full software development lifecycle (SDLC) and includes specialized skills in areas of great demand. Providing systems and application,development and support with a strong understanding of business process and software development. Demonstrating authentic commitment to quality and client relations with detail-oriented skills. Working independently or in a team environment, can work across multiple functional areas being equally comfortable as an advisory, individual contributor, or participating as part of a team, in both remote and onsite settings.

Whether you need one skill set or a full scale project. For weeks, months, or years.

    * Project, Program, and Portfolio Management
    * Business Analysis
    * Architecture
    * Information Management, Data, and Analytics
    * Application Development, Computer Programming
    * Integration
    * Quality Assurance and Test
    * Maintenance and Support
    * BI / DW ETL Reporting

company.name: Independent Information Technology and Services Professional

positions.title: Tax Mentor
positions.description: Run  MyFreeTaxes tax site in Madison County for an IRS-sponsored program called VITA (Volunteer Income Tax Assistance program) which provides free federal, state, and local tax preparation services to low-income families, people with disabilities and the elderly. Trained and certified through the IRS and MyFreeTaxes software, supervise computer labs, work with other Tax Mentors to schedule sites, be available for clients who have questions about filing their taxes. This position requires supervising taxpayers, outreach to the community and executing many logistical details that will ensure that clients are being served well.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Section programmer for Advancement Services. Secondary support programmer for Human Resources, Registrar, Accounts Payable,Accounts Receivable and Financial Aid. Secondary Administrator for Oracle Operational Data Store (ODS), and Oracle Electronic Data Warehouse (EDW), Workflow and Cognos. Lead Data migration programmer for conversion from mainframe environment using Cobol, Focus (4Gl), VSE (VAX) and Alpha to Oracle 10g. Development and maintenance of database applications in PL/SQL (scripts, views, functions, triggers, packages and cursors) utilizing LINUX shell scripting. Maintained Oracle Forms and Reports. Developed and maintained report programs using the Cognos Development Suite,  Responsible for portions of system design and development as a Project Developer. Perform key development duties such as needs assessment, user interface design, security assessment, programming, and interfacing with end users, database design, workflow analysis, business process engineering, web development, and system upgrade activities. Translate client documents, e.g., letters, invoices, reports, into functional, system-generated objects. Re-engineer reports and documents module to better accommodate user needs while reducing complexity and increasing usability. Manage several change control items including gathering requirements, creating estimates, making and implementing changes, and supporting users. Develop Interfaces and integration with third party system: Evisions Argos reporting and FormFusion, Runner Technologies Clean Address, iModules, TouchNet, Blackboard.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description: Using Cobol, IDMS, CICS, SAS and MVS. Worked in the Catalog Distribution Department where developed a customized menu systems used in the mail order system, that identified user id's which implemented on-line security and defined access to different areas in their system. Performed Year 2000 application program conversion.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Develop and implement complex new programs or enhancements to existing computer programs and data stores on moderately complex projects satisfying client requests. Develop supporting documentation, job control language or command language for testing and production. Develop unit test plan for the program, including the test objectives, test scripts, and test cases with expected results and test data. Conducts unit tests of the program. Plan and conduct string tests. Create test packet and complete checklist. Conduct migration walkthrough. Monitor the initial production runs for validity. Troubleshoot program problems within systems.  Provide guidance to programmers and senior programmers by helping them with more difficult problems, or with the use of certain tools or techniques utilizing COBOL, DB2, CICS, Java and web service development . Create technical specifications. Monitor the progress and quality of the assigned work. Develop in-depth application-specific knowledge for multiple applications. Communicate to team members and clients. Report time and status information for tasks and projects. Records system statistics to measure quality and quantity of work. 

* Maintenance and new development in Auto and total casualty claims.
* Installation and maintenance of Auto on-line payment entry project for auto, school bus, and claims.
* Develop changes to Auto front end processing system, providing balancing and transaction selection.
* Auto rate changes, territorial changes, new medical coverage, premier discount changes, surcharge review signal change and miscellaneous change request.
* Equifax Scoring reports for auto and claims.
* NAII reporting.

positions.title: Senior Analyst
positions.locationName: 1711 I Ave in New Castle, Indiana 47362
positions.description:
Supervise and manage MIS department for a custom manufacturing firm including such task as cost estimating, budget planning, man power planning, employee selection, performance reviews, salary administration, and strategic planning. 

•	Organize and implement migration from an off-site data center and in-house 4331 to in house 9375, result in annual cost savings of $144,000.
•	Restructure and improve data center level of service at 7 days/week-24 hours/day uptime: 1992 - 97.3%, 1993 - 98.7%, and 1994 through 1995 - 99.8%.
•	Administer and implement multiple projects to reduce data center operating cost resulting in a percentage reduction from each prior year: 1990 – 7.5% , 1991 - 32.9 %, 1992 - 32.6%, 1993 - 1.7%, 1995 - 21%.
•	Implement VSE/ESA change from SSX/VSE saving 18,000/year.
•	Migration from a remote data center to another remote data center.
•	Installation of language compilers.
•	Installation of Xerox Business Management Systems software packages.
•	Installation and maintenance of mainframe and pc networks.
